title: cone r1=1e7 r2=9e6 h=0.10300645387285069: seam gap 3e-07 mm, above 2 eps_num (G11 PASS)
derivation: Seam gap l2 (2 pi - Phi) = 3e-07 mm (mpmath, 40 digits) for a cone of apex radius about 1e7 mm. The numerical error of its written vertices is about 7e-8 mm, so the seam cannot be told from a closed one below about 1.5e-7 mm (twice that error): the gap is above that band, so G11 passes.
